apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.3.1 — Background playback fix: phrase loops (LoopLab Swaras, Raga Listen, Compose) played one pass and stopped when the app was backgrounded, because the loop restart fires after a silent gap and iOS suspends the app in that gap. The tone engine now runs a silent loop under phrase playback so the app stays alive across the gap; it stops a few seconds after the last note. Includes v1.3.0 (Varisai Practice Dock layout).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrase loops keep playing in the background; Varisai Practice Dock.
